definition: Emotional deprivation is an early maladaptive schema involving a lasting sense that one’s emotional needs were not adequately met, for example through unmet needs or subtle forms of neglect in early development. In this context, it is understood as a schema-level vulnerability linked with later emotion regulation difficulties and psychological distress.

The packet treats Emotional Deprivation as an early maladaptive schema measured in a study of psoriasis comorbidity with psychological distress, but it does not support the definition’s placement under “diagnosis”; the packet does not present this term as a diagnostic category.
